topics.title: Stern Confronts Caller Over AIDS Remarks
topics.summary: During a live broadcast, Howard Stern engages in a heated exchange with a caller expressing anti-AIDS sentiments. The conversation escalates as Stern and other hosts criticize the caller’s views regarding individuals living with HIV/AIDS, highlighting concerns about insensitive remarks.

topics.title: Eddie Murphy Radio Interview – A Frustrating Session
topics.summary: During a radio interview with Eddie Murphy, the host struggled to elicit engaging responses from the comedian. Despite attempts to discuss his music and past appearances, Murphy remained largely unresponsive and dismissive, punctuated by lengthy silences and an entourage that seemed more interested in observation than participation; ultimately, the interaction proved unproductive for both parties.

topics.title: Crazy Eddie, a Tennis Bit, and Producer Frustration
topics.summary: During the radio show, hosts promote Crazy Eddie while struggling with an overbearing producer who criticizes their interview style. They then transition to a bizarre comedy bit about Martina Navratilova’s relationship with Judy featuring clam anxieties and critiques of NBC entertainment programming before playing a song titled ‘Stern Entertainment.’

topics.title: Radio Ramblings & Mental Patients
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio segment, hosts discuss bizarre callers and outlandish situations. A woman named Celeste with an obsession for leopard print drags her leg while discussing pregnancy and flat breasts. Another guest, Judy, attempts to congratulate the show on its anniversary but is quickly derailed by Howard's commentary. The broadcast features repeated jokes about 'kablooey,' a call from someone who witnessed Larry King in an elevator, and a bizarre conversation involving a VH1 contract for one of the guests.

topics.title: Anniversary Show - Rambling Conversation
topics.summary: During an anniversary show recording, two individuals engage in a chaotic and tangential conversation filled with personal frustrations, bizarre anecdotes like attempting to interview Judy or soliciting opinions about their appearance on the streets of New York City. They discuss scheduling conflicts, failed attempts at interviews, and unusual possessions such as sea monkeys.

topics.title: Arthur Gold Sales & MTV Awards Discussion
topics.summary: During a radio show discussion, hosts debate Arthur Gold’s equipment sales while discussing the upcoming MTV Music Awards featuring performances by Paula Abdul and John Bon Jovi. They also discuss rumors about Cher's personal life and make lighthearted comments regarding phone answering machines, with one host expressing frustration over unanswered calls.
